news.thesis: WTVA/CBS Nov 6: Colom leads Hyde-Smith by ~1;900 votes (about 0.2%) with 12;000-20;000 affidavit ballots plus ~3;600 absentees uncounted; counties have until Nov 13 to certify; NRSC demanding affidavit ballots be segregated and both camps preparing to litigate; a 0.2% margin with contested ballots and certification landing one day before the deadline makes an AP call before Nov 14 far from certain; my P(no call) 0.30 v market NO ~0.10-0.15; thin market anchored on a quick call

Eagles injury report Nov 5 17:45 ET: benched QB McKee downgraded to limited with rib injury while starter Milton is not listed; RotoWire says he may miss the game with rookie Payton backing up; my P(yes) 0.06 v market 0.28 bid/0.32 ask; thin prop still priced near a backup with real playing time and the Eagles are auditioning QBs so a quick return to McKee is unlikely
